## In progress

- `2.2.1` `MemoryStorage` implementing all ops incl. `put_if_absent` atomicity (M2)
- `2.2.2.1` Inject: error on Nth call, latency, torn put (partial bytes), dropped put (M2)
- `2.2.2.2` Seeded RNG schedule so failures are reproducible (M2)
- `2.2.2.3` Inject "applied, response lost" (write lands, call returns `Transient`); [T] a retried `put_if_absent` finding its own write returns `Created` (SPEC §10.1) (M2)
- `2.2.3` [T] conformance test-suite (generic over `Storage`) reused by every backend (M2)

## Ready next (first 15 todo leaves whose milestone deps are done)

- `2.3.1` Atomic `put`: write temp → fsync → rename → fsync dir (M2)
- `2.3.2` `put_if_absent` via `O_EXCL`/`link` semantics (M2)
- `2.3.3` `get_range` using pread; `list` with prefix; `delete` (M2)
- `2.3.4` Path-safety: reject `..`, absolute keys, invalid UTF-8; segments over 255 bytes and (Windows) reserved names and trailing `.`/space as `InvalidInput`; `list` never resolves a prefix as a path (SPEC §10.1); [T] traversal attempts (M2)
- `2.3.5` Run conformance suite (M2)
- `2.3.6` Mapped reads of committed container ranges via `MmapFile` (SPEC §4.7, ADR-0010): opt-in, or automatic only on local disk filesystems; `pread` fallback otherwise; mapping granularity (per frame vs `log_end` window); the only `unsafe` call site outside `persia-format` (M2)
- `2.4.1.1` Exclusive writer lock (`flock`) with clear error when held (M2)
- `2.4.1.2` Read-only open mode (also when rocompat flags unknown) (M2)
- `2.4.2` Append frames with group-fsync API (`append`, `sync`) (M2)
- `2.4.3.1` [T] crash simulation: fail after each step 1/2/3, reopen, assert previous or new commit visible, never partial (M2)
- `2.4.4.1` Choose superblock, scan from `log_end`, truncate torn tail (M2)
- `2.4.4.2` [T] an invalid frame in `wal_start..log_end` is `Corrupt` and never truncated; creating a container never truncates an existing file (SPEC §4.7, §8.6) (M2)
- `2.4.5.1` Dead-space accounting (M2)
- `2.4.5.2` [T] crash during compaction leaves a valid old or new file (M2)
- `2.4.5.3` Windows: test whether an open mapping blocks `rename` over the container; if so, close mappings or defer the swap until readers drain (ADR-0010) (M2)
